limitations: Inspection is not an independent blinded review.
No fresh build was performed to attest source-to-binary reproducibility.
This reviews the explicit host boundary, not every compiler/VM primitive or all application source provenance.
observations: Only io::length, io::byte and io::put are registered by the comparison bridge.
Callbacks count bytes, index bytes and append bytes; they do not perform JSON, graph or geometry operations.
Registry preflight requires every host declaration to have a binding and registration requires matching signatures.
Installed host rejects an extra callback and an altered byte signature.
Nonzero guest exit and a host-index trap publish no buffered output.
Invalid UTF-8 and non-JSON bytes echo unchanged; modified disk source runs without rebuilding the host.
review_type: implementation inspection and installed-binary behavior tests
